newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap ADR still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap ADR still a buy.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co has reiterated its buy recommendation on the level one American Depositary Receipts of Brazilian auto parts giant Cofap.

-- The brokerage cited Cofap's strong profits of $0.62 per ADR in the third quarter versus a loss of $0.92 a year earlier, and second-quarter profits of $0.56 versus a Bear, Stearns estimate of $0.45.

-- It said the improved result was due to a jump in gross margin to 32 percent from 20 percent as Cofap continues to benefit from a restructuring program aimed at cutting costs and raising productivity.
-- Despite the better earnings, Bear, Stearns said it is maintaining its 1996 earnings estimate of $1.60 per ADR due to an expected slightly weaker fourth quarter.
-- Cofap's preferred was trading at 8.80 reais at 1152 local/1352 GMT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
